Scholarship_Name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana
Gujarat_Applicability_Reason: Flagship Gujarat State higher education scheme requiring Gujarat domicile and study in recognized Gujarat institutions
Original_Category_Term: All categories (General, EWS, SEBC, SC, ST)
Course_Specific: Medical, Dental, Engineering, Pharmacy, Architecture, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Ayurveda, Homeopathy, Non-Professional Degree, Diploma, D2D
Academic_Criteria: 80th percentile in Class 10 (for Diploma) or Class 12 (for Degree); 65% in Diploma for D2D Degree admissions
Institution_Eligibility: Recognized Higher Secondary / University / College in Gujarat
Income_Criteria_Original: Family annual income up to Rs. 6,00,000
Benefit_Description: Tuition assistance (50% of tuition up to Rs. 2.00L for Medical/Dental, Rs. 50K for Engg/Pharmacy/Prof, Rs. 25K for Diploma, Rs. 10K for BA/BCom/BSc), Hostel assistance of Rs. 1,200/month (10 months = Rs. 12,000/yr), and one-time Book/Instrument assistance up to Rs. 10,000.

Selection_Process: Merit-cum-means based on board percentile and income eligibility verification
Eligibility_Explanation_Template: You are eligible for MYSY if you have Gujarat domicile, scored 80+ percentile in 10th/12th (or 65% in Diploma for D2D), and your family annual income is <= Rs. 6,00,000.
Ineligibility_Exclusion_Template: Ineligible if family income exceeds Rs. 6.00L, score is below 80 percentile (or 65% for D2D), or studying outside Gujarat.
Verification_Notes: Verified against official MYSY Government Resolutions.
